source.title: Example: OEM fault-code reference, ignition section

payload.description: EEC sensed a crankshaft-speed deviation beyond the permitted window on cylinder 1 during the last complete combustion cycle.
possible_causes: Ignition coil on cylinder 1 open circuit
Spark plug gap out of tolerance on cylinder 1
Fuel injector flow deviation on cylinder 1

notes: Copy this file, rename it to <kebab-case-intake-id>.json and replace every placeholder. Unknown fields stay null or [] — never invented.
